svg.title: Tatawwu Bahrain — project design specification
svg.text: Express & Postman · Success responses · Paths are relative to the backend server URL · Protected requests use Bearer JWT
TATAWWU' / BAHRAIN / ENGLISH / MERN + JWT + CLOUDINARY
Edit campaign or cover before start
Mark attended or absent after end
Owner = organizer owning the campaign's organization. Registrant = volunteer owning the registration.
Join: 201 for a new registration; 200 for an existing/reactivated registration. Duplicate active requests never reserve another place.
Discovery filters: q, governorate, area, category, from, to, page. Bahrain dates; 12 results per page, ordered by start time.
Delete only never-published draft/rejected campaigns without registrations. Cancellation preserves historical records.
